title: Uniformizer cone comparison and uniform reduction bound
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $A=\mathcal O_E$, a uniformizer $\varpi$, and $I=(\varpi)$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For any scheme $T$, use the completed coefficient sheaf $A_T=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(A/I^n)_T$ and the derived module category and canonical reductions of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Let $M\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(A_T))$, let $a\leq b$ be integers, and suppose $\mathcal H^q(M)=0$ for $q\notin[a,b]$ [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]. For every $n\geq1$, write $M_n=M\otimes^L_{A_T}(A/I^n)_T$ and let $\operatorname{Res}_n M_n$ be its restriction of scalars along $A_T\to(A/I^n)_T$ [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. There is a natural distinguished triangle
$$M\xrightarrow{\varpi^n\operatorname{id}}M\longrightarrow\operatorname{Res}_n M_n\longrightarrow M[1].$$
Consequently $\mathcal H^q(M_n)=0$ for $q\notin[a-1,b]$, with the same interval for every positive $n$. The triangle is in $D(\operatorname{Mod}(A_T))$ [def-weil-triangulated-category]; no identification of the constant- and completed-coefficient ambient categories is asserted.

proof.text: Reuse the completed DVR coefficient resolution constructed in coefficient_resolution of AdicReductionCohomologySequence. Its first arrow is obtained by conjugating multiplication by the uniformizer power through the constant-to-completed unit comparison. Prove that the completed scalar map used in that construction equals pbcCompletedScalar by the uniqueness of the constant scalar map and the limit projection formulas. Evaluate the conjugated multiplication at 1 using the constant generator and the ordinary scalar-adjunction unit. It is exactly the completed section of the uniformizer power. The tensor multiplication formula therefore identifies tensoring this first arrow with scalar multiplication on every module.

proof.text: Use the independent-coefficient functorial flat-cover construction and its reduced left-resolution functor P with augmentation rho. Its augmentation is a quasi-isomorphism, its terms are flat by preservation of colimits and closure of flat objects under integer-indexed colimits, and its categorical K-flatness implies IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients by tensoring the quasi-isomorphism from zero to an acyclic complex. Tensor the coefficient resolution degreewise with P(X). The tensor_complex_exact calculation from AdicReductionTriangle gives a short exact complex sequence whose first arrow is uniformizer-power scalar multiplication and whose second arrow is the ordinary scalar-adjunction unit.

proof.text: The natural universal derived-extension counit on cochain representatives, followed by exact derived restriction, compares derived reduction with ordinary reduction. On P(X) this comparison is invertible by K-flatness. Combine its inverse with the derived augmentation isomorphism to obtain a natural comparison of ordinary reduction of P(X) with derived reduction of X. The normalization clause of pbcDerivedScalarAdjunction_exists identifies the second arrow with the derived scalar-adjunction unit. This uses actual natural transformations, not objectwise choices of connecting maps.

source.place: Tag 06YY; the recorded universal extension counit and normalized derived scalar adjunction

proof.text: Apply Mathlib triangleOfSES to the degreewise short exact complex sequence. Naturality of triangleOfSESdelta gives a natural transformation on complexes. Conjugate by the two natural comparison isomorphisms, and descend its connecting transformation through the fully faithful whiskering functor of the quasi-isomorphism localization Q. Transport the distinguished triangles first along the resolution isomorphisms, then along the essential-surjectivity isomorphism of Q. Scalar multiplication commutes with those isomorphisms by linearity. This proves the natural distinguished triangle simultaneously for all derived objects.

proof.text: For q<a-1 or q>b, both H^q(M) and H^(q+1)(M) vanish. Apply DerivedCategory.HomologySequence.exact3 to the constructed triangle and ShortComplex.Exact.isZero_of_both_isZero. Finally n>=1 identifies (n-1)+1 with n, so the same interval [a-1,b] works for every positive exponent, including n=1.
